dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: What, did you get stumped by Old Chou's games again?

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: C'mon, I told you already... That treasure hunt of his works like this: the <color=#00E1FFFF>better the goods, the more explosive barrels there will be around it, and vice versa.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Got it this time?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: You Treasure Hoarder dreg... *pants* If I wasn't so exhausted from lacking any... mushrooms to eat lately...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: I would have beaten you black and blue already!

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: You old thief! How dare you call my Glaze L... I mean, Qingxin! How dare you call them mushrooms and just... pick and eat them!

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: *cough* By what right do you get to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, why are you two fighting?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: I—I was looking for mushroom-meat! Haha, yes, mushroom-meat! But they wouldn't let me back into the mines, no! So I—I came here looking for some.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: And after searching and searching, I finally found that there were mushrooms here! But just as I was reaching for them, this cad attacked me out of nowhere!

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: #Hah! A cad? He's the one who violated our Guhua training grounds! And what's more, these flowers belong to me... and the heroic {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And the heroic Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Yes, and the heroic Paimon! Other than the three of us, none may touch these sacred grounds!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Treasure Hoarder dreg!

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Scandalous old crook!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, Uncle He, Tang Wuchou has stopped being a Treasure Hoarder already. Also, the stuff he planted are flowers, not mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Eh? Is that so?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, have a closer look. These are Qingxin for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: Ah! Indeed, they are Qingxin! It appears that I'm still a little dizzy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And you, Tang Wuchou, are you seriously still dreaming of growing that "great Glaze Lily garden" of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Well, it would be a most beautiful sight to see, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whatever the problem is, stop fighting!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle He
dialogues.text: *sigh* No mushrooms. Goodbye, I go.

dialogues.speaker: Claims to be "Tang Wuchou"
dialogues.text: Now that that troublesome old geezer is gone, I can finally look into planting some flowers...
